newsitem.title: JAPAN: NEC to launch world's largest memory supercomputer.
newsitem.headline: NEC to launch world's largest memory supercomputer.

text.p: NEC Corp said on Wednesday that it would launch at the end of December a supercomputer with a memory capacity of 32 gigabytes, the largest in the world.
Existing models in NEC's SX-4 series of supercomputers have memory capacities of eight gigabytes.
The new model will be able to process information much faster than existing models, a company spokesman said.
The supercomputer will be used for such things as analysing aircraft flights, jet engine construction and nuclear fusion, the company said in a statement.
It will rent for at least 2.5 million yen per month, the spokesman said.
